verdict.rationale: LegalOS builds some public content on official USCIS material. Its fee calculator estimates USCIS filing fees, including the Asylum Program Fee, Premium Processing and the 50/50 rule, and its EB-1A blog maps the USCIS EB-1 criteria. The site also points users to uscis.gov for forms. However, none of these items shows explicit policy citations or source links backing its claims. Missing for 10: USCIS processing-time or approval-rate data, FOIA statistics, explicit official policy citations with links (e.g., Policy Manual, CFR, Federal Register fee rule), and independent verification that the fee figures match the official schedule.
